'''Armatin the Dread''' was an old friend of [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo's]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] who retired on [[Tholatin]] before the [[Black Fleet Crisis]]. While retired he bought a [[slava bar]] where he was often found, drunk.
